title: How Did Ancient Persia Keep Ice in the Desert?
audience_promise: AION gives viewers a short, evidence-based explanation of how yakhchal structures used cold nights, shade and deep earthen storage.
wonder_hook: How could people keep ice in a desert before electricity?

age_layers.children: Solve the ice-in-the-desert mystery with AION.
age_layers.family: Notice how shade, water and a deep room work together.
age_layers.deeper: Keep the reconstruction boundary in mind: yakhchal designs differed by place and period.

character: AION, a translucent cyan AI storyteller, visibly present in every scene.
history_boundary: Yakhchal designs and practices differed across places and periods. This short explains documented principles, not one universal reconstruction.

sources.title: UCL Discovery: New insight on passive ice making and seasonal storage of the Iranian Yakhchal

scenes.visual: AION stands in a moonlit Persian desert holding a glowing piece of ice beside a yakhchal.
scenes.narration: In a desert summer, ice sounds impossible. So how did people keep it before electricity?

scenes.visual: AION guides viewers through a cutaway yakhchal dome and its deep underground ice store.
scenes.narration: A yakhchal used cold nights, shaded water and a deep earthen chamber to slow heat down.

scenes.visual: AION holds ice beside the yakhchal at sunrise and invites the viewer to keep wondering.
scenes.narration: The details varied across time and place, but the design shows how many small ideas can work together.

motion.scene_2: gentle vertical reveal through the cutaway chamber

audio: Warm English narration with desert night ambience; no music that overwhelms the explanation.
